title: Thimsy Thimsy/theme.json
description: The theme switches (XMB, ES-DE, Minima and the like, with their style switches) and each theme's settings, shared by every device using the card; the card's value wins over the device's while the card is in (OA-51; LIBRARY-FORMAT.md 4.26; per_device_config_plan.md 2.4). Keys are tools/nano-tree/prefs.json's 'ini' names of the rows marked card: theme; values are strings in the device store's own encoding. Unknown keys are kept, so the theme object is open. Never holds the aspect ratio or any other screen-dependent key. Thimsy-new file. Only the draft-07 keywords devicejson.py validates are used.

pref_key.description: A prefs.json 'ini' name: dotted, lower case.
